Monthly meeting

Come & Stitch

3rd Saturday · 10 am – 12 pm Open to all

A relaxed, social stitching time open to everyone — free and open to the public, no guild membership required. Bring any needlework project you like and enjoy the community and conversation. The format alternates month to month, so some gatherings are on Zoom and others are in person — check the calendar for each date. It’s a brand-new group, so please join us as we stitch and build community together.
